notes: New Jersey's expedite ladder is not available online: the schedule limits it to over-the-counter transactions, with Same Day restricted further to fax filings. The base Certificate of formation fee on the same page is $100.00. Every tier here is read from the Limited Liability Company (LLC) Filing Fees block; the LLP block immediately below carries an identically priced ladder, which is why the quotation is anchored on the LLP heading that follows it — without that anchor the two blocks are indistinguishable in the page text.
